newsitem.title: CHINA: Guangzhou Inv in Shanghai housing deals.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv in Shanghai housing deals.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co said on Tuesday it has signed contracts to invest HK$550 million in three low-price housing projects in Shanghai.

The deals, signed with local governments in Shanghai on Monday, reflects the company's strategy to expand into low-end housing projects and to enlarge recurrent income from its property business, it said in a statement.
The contracts will provide a net fixed return of 15 percent per annum on the cumulative amount invested by the firm, the investment arm of southern China's Guangzhou municipal government.
The projects, expected to generate a total gross floor area of 233,270 square metres, represent part of the Shanghai government's plan to redevelop the city's old urban centres, the firm said.
"With these land lots conveniently situated in the existing urban centre, the company is confident that there will be strong demand for the low-price residential projects," it said.
Local partners will undertake responsibilities for site clearance, construction and sales, the statement said.
After three years, the company will have an option either to reinvest the principal into other similar new projects or recover the principal amount from the Shanghai authorities.
The firm said it is also negotatiating similar fixed-return, low-price housing schemes in Guangzhou, where the bulk of its property business is located.
